clips.title: The story
paras: At the Bulwark, High Executor Derrington directs the Forsaken vanguard against threats from the Western Plaguelands. A no-nonsense military officer, he sends seasoned champions toward contested ruins such as Andorhal and Scholomance.

At the Bulwark’s barricades, High Executor Derrington gives orders to those crossing from Tirisfal Glades into the Western Plaguelands. He has little patience for political maneuvering in the Undercity and sees the front lines as a crucible of sheer survival. Horde soldiers and sellswords receive direct orders to scout plague-ridden territory and blunt enemy incursions before they reach Tirisfal.

The Bulwark faces threats from the Scourge in Andorhal and from the Scarlet Crusade farther north. Scourge forces spread corruption through cauldrons in the countryside, while the Crusade’s zealous fanatics contest northern fortifications and skirmish relentlessly with Forsaken patrols. Derrington coordinates surgical counterattacks, sabotage against Scarlet lines, and systematic disruption of Scourge cauldron fields to protect the eastern border.
